storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
You need not fear his black eye patch; the smothering darkness will not obscure his boundless compassion. The sightless body may have perished, yet the will for redemption endures. Before him, everything should be loved, and everything will be loved in turn.

The words of the Our Father are forever engraved onto the Tablet, and through these blessed flesh and bones, He will bestow upon you "The Blessing".

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Report on Anomalous Events in the Londinium Church District (Confidential)

A.F. 315, February 3rd: During the anomalous event in the Londinium Church District, Bishop Salvador utilized the power of "The Blessing" to heal the Mythag Keeper and the residents of Londinium, exposing his identity as an Awakener in the process.

Due to the insufficient spirit power of the linker, Bishop Salvador chose to exhaust himself to sustain "The Blessing" until the Keeper and the Awakener Ogier shattered the core of said anomaly—the Ritual Mirror. Subsequently, the Keeper took over Salvador's link, and "The Blessing" healed all individuals present, preventing any casualties.

It was discovered that Bishop Salvador's original linker was the former Bishop of the Church District, now the Archbishop of Londinium ■■■■■.

In A.F. 300, the Archbishop had accidentally awakened Salvador after coming into contact with the Holy Ash. Over the next five years, Salvador had served as an assistant priest in the Church District, succeeding him as the Bishop of the Church District following ■■■■■'s promotion.

After the incident, the Keeper agreed to keep Bishop Salvador's Awakener identity confidential; thus, this information was not shared with the Mystia Treaty Committee. Apart from the core personnel of Mythag University, no one is currently aware of his identity as an Awakener.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Every time His Excellency the Bishop visits Mythag University, he is warmly welcomed by teachers and students alike.

The young Awakeners would tug at his hand, asking him to tell more stories from before the Flood. Students would also seek his counsel, inquiring if the Bishop would lend an ear to their troubles and woes. Even the seemingly cold and strong Awakeners and knowledgable professors approach the Bishop when he has free time: either to share their nightmares or to discuss the truths of the Soul.

His patience is unending, never tiring; Anyone may find acceptance and warmth with him.

"Of course, my child, is there aught I can do for you?"

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
"...In the southern Constante Federation, there was told a legend of 'The Blessing Bishop.' Before the Flood, 'The Blessing Bishop' came from the Central Church, and in his devotion and kindness, established the only orphanage in the area, sheltering the many sick and displaced refugees during a devastating plague.

The plague was fierce, sparing noone from its wrath. The bishop prayed day and night, eventually receiving the Father's blessing—a life-giving tablet. He performed miracles, resurrecting the dead and healing those gravely ill from the plague, using his own flesh and blood as divine offerings. Yet regardless of his miracles, this benevolent bishop was framed as a cohort of demons, and ultimately sentenced to death by burning at the stake.

Coincidentally, during the same period, there were reports of a 'Blood Heretic' in the central @2 (now near Bondos in the southern Constante Federation). According to the 'Continental Inquisition Heresy Records,' this heretic held a tablet marked with demonic symbols, performing rituals with flesh and blood, and conducting wicked ceremonies on moonless nights. The heretic was captured by the Inquisition in 107 BD,and in his sincere repentance to the Father, was also sentenced to death by burning at the stake.

 Undeniably, there are many similarities between 'The Blessing Bishop' and the 'Blood Heretic': The same era, same region, same use of tablets and rituals. Considering the Inquisition's strong subjectivity, it is likely they stigmatized certain individuals as heretics. If we were to believe coincidences, the legendary 'Blessing Bishop' might have indeed been real, possibly even the 'Blood Heretic' recorded by the Inquisition..."

—Excerpt from 'Our Gods: Religion and Folk Beliefs in Southern Constante Federation'

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
"The benevolent Father once said: Cherish all things within the sky, on the ground, in the water, and in the soil. For all beings are my offspring.

"Thus, I say: Render all suffering unto me. Let those tormented by life or plagued by disease be made whole. Let all pain and madness melt as frost before the rising sun. Let you, my brethren, receive joy everlasting. 

"Burn me, grind my bones to dust, and rend my flesh asunder. For as long as you can find solace, I have little complaints."

—B.F. 1@1, May 30, Sal @1doMartin @2I @1as, left at @3 the Tribunal

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Our meeting must be a promise from the Father to those who suffer. You are the Pale Flame that dispels calamity, and I shall be your arm, standing faithfully by your side.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: The tempering of a person involves not just the body, but the heart as well.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: If I can free this world from its suffering, I shall be content.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Give me your commands, Pale Messenger. May your flames ever light my path.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Those with strength must not use their power to oppress others, for you all share my blood." I remember the teachings of our Father God of Compassion. I will use this strength only to protect those around me.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: This warmth deep within my soul... Thank you for this gift, Pale Flame. With this power, perhaps I can finally fulfill my duty as His emissary and save more of His children.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: The All-Father once said: 'Suffering is not my creation. Bear and dissolve it, my emissaries, and build a land without suffering.' For this, I would offer everything. Even my life.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: In the face of the all-consuming curse of Dissolution, other sufferings pale. Even if I cannot bear the curse for others, I will do my utmost to alleviate their pain.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Am I now able to ease their pain and comfort their souls?

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Thus, I shall bear all suffering, to pave the way for all beings to a land free from pain.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: There is no need for courtesy, Pale Messenger. There should be no barriers between us, for we are both the All-Father's creations, walking together on this muddy and testing path.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Will you pray with me, my Pale Flame? Let us pray for those who died in our battle today. Though cursed with dissolution and madness, they are still children of the All-Father, our brothers and sisters. May they now find their deserved peace.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: No, I do not fear them. I feel only sorrow for those poor souls tormented by Dissolution. I know I cannot bear their suffering for them, but I would give them all that I have if it brings a moment's comfort.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Regret? No, of course not. My death eased their suffering and bought more time, and that is enough. But... as you have been honest with me, I shall not hide this: the pyre that day left its scars upon my heart.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: Even though the red flames make me uneasy, I would step onto the burning platform for you once more. Do not dwell on it, my Pale Flame. My sacrifice is insignificant next to the blessings you bring.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Your hands are warm, like your soul. I... appreciate your touch, Pale Flame.

daily.title: Chat: About a Chapel
daily.content: A chapel? Thank you, but I am not so old-fashioned. As long as I keep the teachings of the God of Kindness in my heart and follow His will, my soul will never stray from His glory.

daily.title: Chat: About Fatigue
daily.content: The burden of guiding light can overwhelm even the purest of saints. If you feel weary, my pale flame, please confide in me. I will do everything in my power to ease your burden and share the weight of these countless blessings.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: If I had known sooner that those people were tormented by this all-consuming curse, I... No, it is not too late. I must eradicate it, and eliminate all suffering, even if it costs me my life once more.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: They call me a master counselor? Those children are too kind. I simply do my best to listen and help them release their inner distress—as I have always tried to do.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: A world untouched by sorrow, untainted by grief, free from pain and unmarred by suffering... perhaps an unattainable illusion, but it is the ideal I have pursued all my life.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: I believe all things happen for a reason, but... the senseless violence, the prejudices that drive siblings to turn against each other... these things truly sadden me. If there is anything I detest, it is that.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper: I
daily.content: Since the day you Awakened me from darkness, I have been certain that you can save all from the despair of Dissolution, and bring them to the sinless land. I await that day with a hopeful heart.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper: II
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocks after clearing Special Operation "Color of Blood"
daily.content: Let me express my gratitude once again, Keeper, for respecting my wishes and keeping my secret from the Committee. I fear their intervention would see me barred from continuing my service to the Chantry of Life.

daily.title: Chat: About Vision
daily.content: Losing my sight does not mean I have become blind. While the All-Father brought darkness upon me, He also allowed me to see the faint light of souls.

daily.title: Chat: About the "Pale Flame"
daily.content:
Many in the Chantry of Life believe the "white flame" in the Scriptures refers to moonlight: a Pale Messenger appearing from it to lead us from suffering.
But I know the true flame is the soul burning within you and me.

daily.title: Chat: About "Awakeners"
daily.content: For me, the state of being an Awakener is a gift from our All-Father to the souls in His embrace. It is a second life, an opportunity to mend past regrets. I will continue His work, fulfill my duties as His proxy, and alleviate more suffering.

daily.title: Chat: About His "Blessing"
daily.content: After years of this invisible plague, the All-Father finally heard my prayers and bestowed upon me the "Blessing" that can counter suffering. It indeed grants life, but also requires a price. As His executor, I ought to bear that burden on behalf of those blessed.

daily.title: Chat: About Home
daily.content: I may not have been born in the Kingdom of Leo, but the Church of Redemption is where I received my second life. Why, then, can I not consider this place my home?

daily.title: Chat: About His First Life
daily.content: Back then, although I had received "The Blessing," I was just an ordinary man. There were too many who suffered, too many who needed it. I wanted to save them all, but I failed. This is my greatest regret and my eternal guilt.

daily.title: Chat: About Ogier
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocks after clearing Special Operation "Color of Blood"
daily.content: That child is sincere, steadfast, and kind, with a rare bright soul. The last time I met a spirit like this was during the first chapter of my life.

daily.title: Chat: About Hiding Identity
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocks after clearing Special Operation "Color of Blood"
daily.content: In fact, I was told to hide my true identity by the Archbishop. He did not elaborate, but warned me: even in the purest places, shadows may exist, and one must remain cautious, even when doing good. Of course, I trust you completely.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: All of this is for the eternal well-being of the future.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: May His divine love warm your soul.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: No matter how many times we must start over, I will walk alongside you.

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: God treats all His children equally.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Lambs, the All-Father's will shall redeem you.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: All of this is part of His divine plan.

traphase.title: Opening
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: I will follow your guidance, Pale Herald.

traphase.title: Chat: About Tawil
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: As a favored servant of the All-Father, if my path is lined with thorns, then at least let me bleed for all beings until the very last moment.

traphase.title: Chat: About Thais
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: It's not that I have no desires, my lady. I long to erase all agony from the mortal world, and I wish for all beings to partake in the blessed nectar of the Holy Grail.

traphase.title: Chat: About Tulu
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: What we call faith is itself a strength—a power generated from within that can bring happiness, young sir.

traphase.title: Chat: About Doresain
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: I've heard that you have granted the deceased a place to rest and given them meaning. This is indeed a form of redemption for life itself.

traphase.title: Chat: About Mouchette
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: When the mist rises, desire blinds your soul. Only those who endure it can hope for redemption.

traphase.title: Chat: About Arachne
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: If the pain I carry can bring the world its salvation, then all of it is worth the price.

traphase.title: Thinking
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: All the will of redemption has long been recorded in the All-Father's holy words...

traphase.title: Urging
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: No need to worry, the merciful Father will ultimately cure your suffering.

traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase

traphase.title: Blunder
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: This might be an unnecessary fight...
